sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:23

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:23:1
items.html:
Four states, etc. The worst is that both are back to back: These four degrees apply both in ZON and in AVI [Aba ve Ima], but their origin is in AVI. And since they are the first foundations for understanding the Mochin of AVI and ZON, it is fitting to dwell on them at length and to explain them well.
And it has already been explained above (in Part 6) that the Rosh [head] of Nekudim, which is called AVI, is merely the Hotem and Peh of the Rosh in relation to the ten Sefirot of the general Rosh, see there. And from the standpoint of the second Rosh they are the AHP that went outside the Rosh, because the bottom Hey is in the Einayim of Keter, and AVI are found below the screen of the Rosh, and for this reason they are considered HGT. (As written at length in the Inner Light above, page 433, the passage beginning “item 10”)
And you must know that although we said that these AVI are HGT, nevertheless they are considered GAR [first three] and a Rosh from the side of Bina, that is, through the correction of back to back that is in them. And this correction is drawn by the force of the Bina of direct light, for the Bina of direct light is the secret of the light of Hassadim and not of Hochma, in the secret of “for He delights in mercy” (as the ARI writes above, page 329, item 41, and see there in the Inner Light, page 325, the passage beginning “and the face”). Therefore she is discerned as one whose posterior rejects Hochma, while her face is the light of Hassadim alone. And thus HB of direct light are with their posteriors toward one another. (See above, Part 1, page 5, in the Inner Light, the passage beginning “and the reason for the obligation”)
And it was explained above in the words of the ARI (page 413, item 24) that AVI took a little illumination from the light of the Ozen [ear], that is, the light of Bina of the ten Sefirot of the general Rosh (see there in the Inner Light). Therefore the posterior of the light of Bina mentioned above availed them, to sustain them as GAR. And although they are found below the screen of the Rosh, which is in the Nikvey Einayim of Keter — which screen, being the secret of the bottom Hey, withholds from them the illumination of Hochma of the Rosh — nevertheless this is not reckoned to them as a flaw at all, for in any case they have no wish whatsoever to receive the illumination of Hochma, since they crave and delight in Hassadim specifically and reject Hochma, by force of the posterior of the light of the Ozen that rides upon them and imprints this delight in them, in the secret of “for He delights in mercy.”
And with this you will better understand the words of the ARI there (page 415), that the ZAT, which received nothing at all of the illumination of the Ozen, therefore had their vessels broken both anterior and posterior; but AVI, who received a little illumination from the light of the Ozen, had only their posterior broken, while their anterior endured and was not broken, even though they took the illumination of the light of the Ozen at a distance of place. Study it there well.
And with what has been said you will understand the matter well. For it has been explained that through the illumination they received from the posterior of the light of the Ozen, they were not blemished at all by the distance of place — meaning by their having been removed from the Rosh through the bottom Hey in the Einayim of Keter, which withholds from them the illumination of Hochma of the Rosh — because they have no desire whatsoever for the light of Hochma, and even were they in proximity of place, they would likewise reject the light of Hochma from themselves, being with it back to back, as above. Therefore they still have a complete Rosh from this aspect of Bina, and therefore the flaw of the breaking did not rule over them at all in this aspect. And this is the anterior vessels, which endured in their entirety, that is, the face of Bina, which is the secret of the light of Hassadim, as above. And only what they received in their posterior vessels afterwards, through the coupling of the Yesod of AK — that is, that through this coupling they turned their posterior vessels and made them into anterior, meaning that they received the illumination of Hochma in them (see page 325 in the Inner Light, the passage beginning “and the face”) — behold, these vessels alone were broken, because they had already been blemished by the distance of place, having become a Guf [body], as above. And this will be further explained below.
And this is what the ARI says below, that had AVI not been back to back from their beginning, they would then have been broken both anterior and posterior, like the ZAT of Nekudim. That is, as explained, that through this correction of back to back, which is the illumination of the light of the Ozen, as above, they are considered a Rosh even though they are found below the screen of the bottom Hey that is in the Einayim, and therefore the breaking did not rule over them, as above. But had they not had this correction of back to back, they would then have been considered an actual Guf, like the ZAT of Nekudim, for both these and those are merely Hotem and Peh. (As above, page 489 in the Inner Light, the passage beginning “and one should not ask”)
And now the matter of the posterior of Ima toward Hochma has been well explained. However, Aba too is discerned as having his posterior toward Bina, and this is because of the bottom Hey in the Nikvey Einayim of Keter. Therefore Aba cannot bestow anything of Hochma upon Bina, being below the screen, as above. And therefore this is called back to back, for Aba cannot bestow the illumination of Hochma upon Bina because of the posterior of the bottom Hey, so that this is so even if Bina were to turn her face toward Hochma. And correspondingly, Bina would not receive the light of Hochma from Aba even if Aba were to turn his face toward Bina to bestow the light of Hochma upon her, because “He delights in mercy,” as above. And now the state of the first degree, called back to back, has been well explained.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:23:2
items.html:
Above this is back to face; that is, the male turns his posterior toward the face of the female, etc.: And you must know that two diminutions were made in Bina by force of the rising of the bottom Hey to the Einayim. The first is from the side of the screen that was installed in the Einayim, because of which Bina descended to the restricted Malchut, in whom the coupling by striking in the Rosh is made and in whom the whole Partzuf ends, that is, in the Sefira of Bina of NHY, as is known. And the second diminution was made in her by force of the Gevurot, that is, the blockage of the Hassadim in the vessel of Malchut from the source of her emanation.
And the matter of these Gevurot in the vessel of Malchut was explained above in the words of the ARI concerning the light of Malchut that is in the vessel of Yesod, which exists in the Partzuf AB of AK — which is the second expansion of AK, where the lights were exchanged, so that the light of Hochma came into the vessel of Keter, and the light of Bina into the vessel of Hochma, and so on until the light of Malchut in the vessel of Yesod (as written on page 336, item 45, and in the Inner Light there, the passage beginning “returned”). For it is the light of the posterior that remains from the Sefira of Hod, in which there is no longer the illumination of Hassadim of the VAK [six ends] of ZA, and therefore it is discerned there, in the vessel of Yesod, as the five Gevurot. Study it there well. It was also explained there that the root of Malchut is the Sefira of Hod, that is, the fifth Hesed of the five Hassadim, except that she has two diminutions, in Yesod and in Malchut. Study it there well. And therefore Malchut is discerned, from the side of her inclusion in ZA, as having anterior vessels, that is, ones that receive the illumination of Hochma like ZA, only with a blockage of Hassadim. And remember this.
And now the anterior and the posterior found in the vessels of Malchut have been explained, and both of them are Gevurot: for from her own side she is corrected with a screen that rejects Hochma, and this is her posterior; and from the side of her inclusion in ZA, which is the fifth Hesed, Hod, as above, she has the illumination of GAR [first three], only that she is blocked from Hassadim, as explained. And these two diminutions Bina received from Malchut, by force of the rising of the bottom Hey to the Einayim.
And with this you will understand the necessity of these two states, back to back and back to face. For first the first diminution was corrected, which is the harsh posterior of Malchut, caused by the screen and the restriction, which dwell upon Bina because of the bottom Hey in the Nikvey Einayim; and this correction is made through the posterior of Bina, as above in the adjacent item. And after this was corrected, there still remained upon her the second diminution, which is the blockage of Hassadim in the anterior vessel of Malchut, which dwells upon Bina because of the bottom Hey in the Einayim. And this is done through the state of back to face, for the male, who is Hochma, shines in her the light of Hassadim from his posterior, into the anterior vessels of Bina, which suffer from this lack alone — for they do not lack the illumination of GAR, as above. And now Bina is already corrected with respect to the vessels, both in her posterior part and in her anterior part. However, she still receives only the light of Hassadim, from the posterior of Hochma, and she is not yet fit to receive the light of the face, which is the light of Hochma, as written further on.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:23:3
items.html: Above this is face to back, etc.: The first two corrections, which are back to back and back to face, were drawn by force of the posterior of Bina, as above; for the correction of back to back is the secret of the posterior of Bina, which rejects Hochma by force of “for He delights in mercy,” as above. And therefore the matter of the screen does not diminish her at all, for in any case she rejects Hochma, so that in this she is not blemished by the screen whatsoever, as above. And after the posterior was corrected, the correction of the anterior vessels began of itself, for their entire lack was from the blockage of Hassadim, whereas now, after the correction of back to back, they receive Hassadim abundantly from the posterior of Hochma, as above. However, this third degree, which is face to back, meaning the face of the male upon the posterior of the female, comes to him through the coupling of AB SAG, which lowers the bottom Hey from the Einayim to the Peh, whereupon HB return to the Rosh, and then the male, who is Hochma, attains his face as at first. But Bina still remains in the posterior, for she still has no power to receive with her anterior vessels, as written further on.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:23:4
items.html: She has not enough power to receive it through the face: For in truth she is able to receive the light of the face of Hochma, since she is already found above the screen, as in the earlier Partzufim of AK. However, by force of the two preceding corrections, back to back and back to face — the first of which is the posterior of Ima, which delights in Hesed and rejects Hochma, and the second of which is the Gevurot in her anterior vessels, which thirst for the light of Hassadim from their root — therefore Bina holds fast to her posterior, and does not wish to open her anterior vessels to receive the light of Hochma from the male, but only the light of the posterior, that is, Hassadim, as explained. And this is what he says, that she has not enough power to receive it through the face; and this is because of the great craving that she has for the light of Hassadim.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:23:5
items.html:
The light is coarsened there somewhat, etc. She is already able to receive it, since it has been somewhat coarsened: This means that this light of the face, which is received in the posterior vessels of Bina, greatly improves her posterior, until the posterior itself rises to become complete GAR [first three], in such a manner that the anterior vessels become subordinate and receive the light of GAR from the posterior vessels; and thus the posterior vessels are more important than the anterior vessels, since they are the ones that bestow upon them.
And the reason for the matter is that in truth the posterior vessels receive from the light of the face of the male only a very scant illumination, since they are vessels that reject Hochma and yearn only for the light of Hassadim, as above. Yet that same scant illumination which they receive turns the posterior into something more important than the anterior vessels; for at the time when the anterior vessels were receiving Hochma — that is, the light of Malchut in the vessel of Yesod in the earlier Partzufim — they were then in a great blockage from the light of Hassadim, as above, which is the secret of the five Gevurot in Yesod. But these posterior vessels have the light of Hassadim abundantly, and also the scant illumination of Hochma that they receive, as explained.
And this is what he says, that the light is somewhat coarsened, meaning that it is a scant illumination, because of the force of rejection found in the posterior vessels. “And when the light passes through the posterior and reaches her front side, she is already able to receive it, since it has been somewhat coarsened” — meaning that when the anterior vessels were receiving the illumination of Hochma, they were then unable to receive the light of Hassadim, but were Gevurot; whereas now, when they receive the illumination of Hochma by means of the posterior vessels, they have Hochma and Hassadim together.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:23:6
items.html: And the wise one praises her at the back, etc., more than were it the reverse, which is back to face: For Hochma now praises the light of the posterior and makes it into GAR [first three] and into the light of the face. This is not so beforehand, when they were back to face: although they received in the anterior vessels, they received only the light of the posterior from Hochma; whereas now, even though she receives in the posterior vessels, she receives the light of GAR and of the face, as above.
